summary.ko: 모호한 개발 요청을 검증 가능한 작업 범위와 인수 기준으로 바꿉니다.
summary.en: Turn an ambiguous software request into bounded requirements and testable acceptance criteria.

triggers: turn feature request into acceptance criteria
exclusions: Generic business proposals without a software feature
Implementation requests whose acceptance criteria are already complete

required_inputs.description: Original feature request and intended users
Known platform, constraints, and explicitly approved scope

workflow.instruction: Separate stated requirements, inferred assumptions, and unresolved decisions; retain source wording for consequential constraints.
Map the principal user journey and its failure, empty, loading, and permission states.
Write observable Given/When/Then acceptance criteria; distinguish essential behavior from optional enhancements.
Split the work into independently verifiable slices and flag decisions that block implementation without silently deciding them.

deliverables.name: Requirements brief
deliverables.acceptance_criteria: Includes scope, non-goals, assumptions, and unresolved decisions

deliverables.name: Acceptance checklist
deliverables.acceptance_criteria: Each criterion has an ID, expected behavior, and verification method

limitations: Do not invent business rules or imply stakeholder approval.
Cannot establish feasibility without the relevant architecture or code.
permission_boundaries: Produces planning artifacts; does not create tickets, edit a repository, or message stakeholders unless requested.
Do not add analytics collection or user-data access as an unstated requirement.
